upstream.scope: Generic macOS client: saved endpoints and reattachment after a client relaunch (D2 T38 saved sessions; §6.3, §17, §18, §18.2), proven against a live srtop over real SSH; the saved-connections file holds no continuity state, a relaunch attaches with CLIENT_HELLO and a fresh client identity and is ready only after the catch-up snapshot, REPLACED updates the saved session ID, and forgetting an entry is local; no server, SDK, protocol, registry, proto, framing, generated-file or srtop change; round 2: versioned file with move-aside of an unreadable one, validated session IDs, de-duplicated entry IDs

entries.feature: Saved endpoints persist locally in the one existing SavedConnectionStore file (PX-023's; no second store): id, label, host, port, user, the last session ID and the last revision; the revision is presentation metadata only and the Connections row now captions it 'Session <id> · last seen at revision N' (SavedConnection.sessionCaption) rather than as a resume point; a relaunched manager lists the entry with status unknown
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift SavedConnection.sessionCaption, header; ConnectionManager/ConnectionManagerView.swift SavedConnectionRow; SRUITests ConnectionManagerTests, SavedEndpointRelaunchLiveTests

entries.feature: Reattach after a client relaunch uses only the existing session APIs: a new ConnectionManager over the saved file builds a fresh ConnectionSessionContext (new client_instance_id, empty replica), and until a session has been ready in that context (ConnectionSessionContext.hasBeenReady) ConnectionAttemptRequest.resumeSessionID is nil, so it attaches with CLIENT_HELLO (the §18 documented attach path; the cold CLIENT RESUME is only a MAY) and ready follows the WELCOME catch-up snapshot; the remembered revision is never sent; round 2 (verifier F1): a revision-0 CLIENT_RESUME against srtop's default journal got RESUME_OK and was ready at revision 0 before the replay, so it is no longer sent from a cold context; warm contexts resume exactly as before; live: with srtop's default journal and with a one-commit journal, at the moment of ready the replica's revision, rows and item IDs equal the first launch's paused state and the whole tree equals an independent fresh attach; the fresh identity's first event is sequence 1 and srtop processes it (no sequence collision)
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift ConnectionSessionContext.hasBeenReady, ConnectionAttemptRequest.resumeSessionID, makeSessionControllerAttempt; SRUITests ConnectionManagerTests, SavedEndpointRelaunchLiveTests (default journal and --journal-capacity 1)

entries.feature: A double connect after a relaunch respects generation supersession: the first attempt, held after its handshake is on the wire, is superseded by the second, which becomes ready; the first then runs to its end without ready and changes no status, alert, window subtitle or replica revision; round 2 (F2): a superseded attempt whose replaced and ready arrive only after the newer attempt saved changes neither the row nor the file
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift attempt tokens (unchanged); SRUITests SavedEndpointRelaunchLiveTests, ConnectionManagerTests

entries.feature: Forgetting a saved entry is local only: the entry and its file record go and nothing is sent; the srtop process keeps running, the forgotten entry's open transport keeps receiving commits, another client stays connected to the same session, and a copy of the file taken before the forget still reattaches to the same incarnation (SAME_SESSION, not REPLACED); round 2 (F2): a forgotten entry is not brought back when its still-running session later becomes ready
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift remove(id:) (unchanged); SRUITests SavedEndpointRelaunchLiveTests, ConnectionManagerTests

entries.feature: A relaunch against a restarted srtop surfaces the replacement: the HELLO attach's WELCOME names another session than the saved one, so the attempt reports connecting, replaced, ready (SessionControllerConnectionAttempt.rememberedSessionID); a blocking 'Session Replaced' alert names the old and new session IDs; the window says 'session replaced — rebuilding'; the saved file's stale session ID is replaced with the new one (revision 0) before ready, and the ready revision is saved afterwards; the same session ID is no replacement and raises no alert; the RESUME-path REPLACED handling is unchanged
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift SessionControllerConnectionAttempt forwarding, handle(.replaced); SRUITests SavedEndpointRelaunchLiveTests, ConnectionManagerTests

entries.feature: Round 2 (verifier F3): the saved-connections file is versioned ({"connections": [...], "version": 1}; a bare array is the pre-versioned version 1 and still loads); a file load() cannot read (truncated, empty, another shape, revision past UInt64 or negative, unknown version) is moved aside with one rename(2) to the fixed <name>.unreadable, replacing any earlier backup (at most one kept), and the 'Couldn’t Load Connections' alert names that path; later saves write a fresh file and never touch the backup; if the move fails the file is left in place and every save is refused (UnreadableFileInPlace)
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift SavedConnectionStore load/decode/save/backupURL; SRUITests ConnectionManagerTests

entries.feature: Round 2 (verifier F4): session IDs are validated before they are stored, shown or sent: non-empty, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes and 128 Unicode scalars (sessiond mints 32 lowercase hex; §17 makes the ID opaque), and free of every control or invisible scalar ConnectionEndpoint refuses; an invalid saved ID is dropped with its revision and the entry keeps its endpoint and label; an invalid server-reported ID in ready or replaced is not stored and not echoed in the alert; duplicate entry IDs load as the first entry only, so one remove deletes exactly one row
entries.scope: PX-024/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift SavedConnection.validSessionID, SavedConnectionStore.normalized, handle(.ready/.replaced); SRUITests ConnectionManagerTests
